sampling_frame: Frozen next200 probability tasks from the pre-outcome n=300 accuracy expansion; disjoint from first100. Combined n=300 remains a sample of the 1,500-task benchmark, not a census.
blindness: Both providers receive actual released figures, question and all options; never released gold, other judge output, verifier outcome, DeepSeek answer or selection reason.
two_stage_rule: GPT adjudicates all next200. Claude adjudicates every high-confidence unambiguous GPT error flag. Count FP only if both exclude gold. Count FN only for a specific non-gold option both include. All disagreement, ambiguity, error, and unreviewed tasks count as non-errors in cumulative denominator300.
inference: Report cumulative n=300 97.5% Wilson intervals, Bonferroni-adjusted for the two audit looks (first100 and cumulative300), plus paper-group bootstrap at the same confidence. Fail only if a conservative lower bound is strictly above15%; pass only if upper is strictly below15%.
raw_policy: Detailed provider outputs remain outside git; aggregate decisions and raw SHA256 commitments only.
